##### Project general facts

South Living Tower is a contemporary residential development offering a collection of studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments designed to accommodate modern family living. The project features a clean architectural design that combines functional layouts with comfortable interior spaces, creating a practical and welcoming residential environment. Residents are greeted by a double-height entrance lobby enhanced by a feature waterfall wall, while the residences are thoughtfully planned to maximize comfort, usability, and everyday convenience. The overall concept focuses on providing well-designed homes that support an upscale and family-oriented lifestyle.

Residents have access to a range of amenities tailored to recreation, wellness, and family living. These include dedicated children's play areas, wellness and spa-inspired facilities, landscaped communal spaces, visitor parking, and leisure areas designed to encourage relaxation and social interaction. The amenity offering is centered around creating a comfortable residential environment that caters to both families and individual residents.

The residences feature modern finishing with high-quality materials throughout. Interior spaces are designed with a contemporary aesthetic and durable finishes that enhance everyday living. No kitchen appliances are specified. Residences are delivered without furniture. The overall specification reflects a modern design approach focused on comfort, functionality, and quality materials.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai South, also known as the Dubai South Free Zone, is a dynamic and strategically planned district located in the southern part of Dubai. It serves as a major hub for economic, commercial, and logistical activities, designed with a vision to support the growth of various industries. One of its standout features is its proximity to the Al Maktoum International Airport, the world's largest airport in terms of cargo volume, making it a key player in the global logistics and aviation sectors.

In addition to its logistical prowess, Dubai South is home to the Dubai Expo 2020 site, which served as a testament to the district's capacity to host large-scale global events. The Expo site has now transitioned into a legacy district, offering a wide range of amenities and infrastructure, including residential communities, educational institutions, and recreational facilities. Dubai South's commitment to sustainability is evident in its green initiatives, with a focus on eco-friendly urban planning and energy-efficient buildings.

Dubai South continues to grow as a thriving business and residential hub, attracting both international and local investors. Its strategic location, state-of-the-art infrastructure, and diverse range of opportunities make it a compelling destination for businesses and individuals alike, contributing to the ongoing development and economic diversification of Dubai.
